candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in to occur after selecting or creating a pet, allowing users to experience the fun part before creating an account.
candidates.why: High drop-off at adoption (60.9%) and sign-in early on slows momentum. Delaying account creation until after pet choice builds intent.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed in onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in post-value creation is a strong pattern, but no direct support mails mention auth flow.

candidates.title: Clarify Single-Account Pet Retention
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on sign_in clarifying how pets are attached to accounts so users log in with the correct email.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main email to keep your saved pets synced safely.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Redesign Pick Friend Grid Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a dynamic grid layout featuring animated choice cards with pet personality traits.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) with long decision times (median 89s / mean 1017s).

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Add Custom Pet Preview Stage
candidates.change: Insert a new pet preview screen immediately following creation/selection so users confirm graphics before final adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Make sure your new pet looks great before finalizing setup.

guard.reason: Adding a custom pet preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (39.1%) and 3 support tickets report preview/rendering issues.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Live Status
candidates.change: Display explicit status progress and setup instructions during the waiting screen to reassure users while rendering graphics.
candidates.why: The waiting phase has high mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on the desktop.

waiting.hint: Preparing desktop overlay permissions and launching pet graphics...

guard.reason: Displaying status progress and setup instructions during a real wait screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Huge mean wait time (2336s) at home step combined with 3 support mails about missing rendering feedback.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Tour
candidates.change: Turn home_intro into a step-by-step checklist teaching keyboard shortcuts for hiding, showing, and interacting with the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-setup, and finish conversion is 64.8%.

components.text: Press Alt+P to toggle pet visibility anytime.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Streamline Path Selection Headlines
candidates.change: Simplify choose_path copy to highlight quick preset choices versus creating custom pets from scratch.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 76.2% with a mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Pick Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play pet in seconds, or craft a custom friend from your photos.
choose_path.hint: You can always add more pets later.

guard.reason: Updating choose_path copy while retaining both path options complies with rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean time (514s) indicates path confusion; cheap copy change to implement.

candidates.title: Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Video Demo
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro with a split layout featuring a quick video demo showing how the desktop pet behaves on screen.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cite post-onboarding confusion regarding how to interact with desktop pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro overlay with a video demo is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off at finish (35.2%) and support emails mention post-onboarding desktop interaction confusion.

candidates.title: Introductory Story Welcome Screen
candidates.change: Add an engaging intro screen explaining the desktop pet concept before asking users to select a path.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8% and early drop-off occurs at choose_path (76.2%).

new_welcome_story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
new_welcome_story.body: Your new animated friend lives right on your desktop while you work and play.

guard.reason: Inserting a new welcome story screen into onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adds friction with a new screen before path selection without direct support evidence.

candidates.title: Show Adoption Certificate Stamp & Badge
candidates.change: Add an official adoption badge and certificate design to the adoption certificate screen to increase emotional investment.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a long mean duration of 1017s.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset
